Definition: Lesha, a place probably East of the Jordan
BiblicalUsage: Leshaʻ names Lesha, a place probably East of the Jordan, and its appearances in Scripture are few but pointed. In Genesis 10:19, "even unto Lasha".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Lesha marks the edge of the Canaanites' border — one more place on the map God drew for His people.
